ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Project Description

The Department of Informatics at Umeå University offers a postdoctoral fellowship within the project AI Infrastructure for the Forest: Establishment, Use, and Consequences. The application deadline is 15 October 2026. The postdoctoral researcher will be part of the Digital Forestry Lab at the Department of Informatics.

Digital Forestry Lab conducts research on the digitalization of the forestry sector. Within the project, the postdoctoral researcher will conduct qualitative research on the establishment and use of the WIFORCE Arena Data Support Centre, a national research infrastructure that brings together data, expertise, and advanced computing resources for data-driven forest research.

Research Focus

The research focuses on how data, AI systems, and digital infrastructures are shaped, governed, and used within the forestry sector, and on the consequences these developments may have for transparency, accountability, inclusion, and fair decision-making processes. The project offers a unique opportunity to follow the development of a national research infrastructure from its early stages.

Financial Coverage

  • Tax-exempt two-year fellowship funded by the Kempe Foundations.
  • Amount: SEK 360,000 per year.
  • The postdoctoral fellow is expected to be present at the university throughout the fellowship duration.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Doctoral degree in Informatics/Information Systems or another subject area relevant to the project.
  • Eligibility must be met no later than the time the decision regarding the fellowship recipient is made.
  • Priority to candidates who obtained degree within three years prior to application deadline. Special grounds (illness, parental leave, etc.) may extend.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English required.
  • Must have experience with qualitative, empirical research.
  • PhD in Informatics or Information Systems with focus on advanced qualitative methods is particular merit.
  • Basic understanding of AI systems or demonstrated interest in sociotechnical perspectives on digitalization.
  • Strong collaborative skills, ability to engage with stakeholders in private and public sectors.
  • High scientific aptitude, methodological competence, solid theoretical foundation, proven publication record.

Application

Submit via Varbi by 15 October 2026. Required documents:

  • Cover letter (max 2 pages) describing interest, previous research experience, and brief reflection on how to methodologically approach qualitative studies of AI systems and decision-making processes in forestry sector.
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV).
  • List of publications.
  • Copy of doctoral degree certificate or documentation of expected completion; copies of other degree certificates, transcripts, and grade reports.
  • Copy of doctoral thesis and up to five relevant articles.
  • Contact details for two reference persons.

Department of Informatics

Conducts research on digitalization of society, organizations, and interaction. Research spans public sector, media, gaming, entertainment, financial services, entrepreneurship, IT companies, manufacturing, and retail.
